IRCC 2026 international student cap set at 309,670 study permit application spaces — 7% below 2025 target of 437,000; 16% below 2024 target of 485,000. New international student admissions projected to fall from 305,900 to 155,000 (roughly -50%). Master's/doctoral students at public DLIs exempt from PAL/TAL as of January 1, 2026.

BC allocation $3.3B postsecondary, +$600M y/y. McGill redevelopment (former Royal Victoria Hospital site) $870M. University of Victoria 510-bed residence — groundbreak May 2026, revised completion 2034 (from 2029).
151 education project records totaling ~$14.7B in projects_all.json.
